'''Mari Amithest''' was a [[Force-sensitive]] [[human]] [[Gender|female]] and a member of the [[Jedi Order]] as a [[Youngling|child]] during the [[Republic Era|last years]] of the [[Galactic Republic]]. Raised within the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant]], Amithest began their [[Jedi training|training]] in the ways of [[the Force]] and [[lightsaber combat]] among other [[Jedi Initiate|Jedi younglings]] as a member of the [[Bear Clan]]. In [[22 BBY]], while practicing their [[lightsaber]] skills under the supervision of [[Grand Master]] [[Yoda]], Amithest's class was visited by [[Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who sought the ancient [[Jedi Master]]'s help in locating the [[planet]] [[Kamino]].

The Grand Master decided to use Kenobi's inquiry to engage his students' problem-solving skills. Amithest's classmate, [[J. K. Burtola]], deduced that the [[Kaminoan]] [[homeworld]]'s location was erased from the [[Jedi Archives]].

==Biography==
Mari Amithest was a [[Youngling|child]];<ref name="AOTC" /> [[Reproduction|born]] at some point between [[30 BBY]] and [[26 BBY]],<ref name="Birth Date" /> they lived during the [[Republic Era|final years]] of the [[Galactic Republic]].<ref name="AOTC" /> Having joined the [[Jedi Order]] at a young age, they became a member of the [[Bear Clan]]<ref name="DB Bear" />—a class of [[Jedi Initiate|younglings]] who [[Jedi training|trained]] together in the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]].<ref name="AOTC" /> In [[22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], which includes Amithest's appearance, to [[22 BBY]].</ref> Amithest and the rest of the Bear Clan were practicing with [[training lightsaber]]s under the tutelage of [[Jedi]] [[Grand Master]] [[Yoda]] in one of the [[Jedi temple|Temple's]] classrooms when the [[Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] interrupted the lesson to seek Yoda's guidance.<ref name="AOTC" />

Yoda halted the class, and Amithest and the others greeted Kenobi, who explained that he was looking for the planet [[Kamino]], but could not find it in the [[Jedi Archives]]. Yoda instructed Amithest's classmate [[Liam]] to lower the classroom's blinds so that Kenobi could show the class a [[Hologram|holographic]] [[star]] map and indicate where the planet should be. The ancient [[Jedi Master]] asked the class if they had any thoughts on why the planet might be missing. Ultimately, [[J. K. Burtola]], another classmate of Amithest, suggested that it was erased from the archives. Satisfied with this answer, Yoda moved away from the younglings to speak briefly with Kenobi about this troubling idea.<ref name="AOTC" />

==Personality and traits==
Mari Amithest was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] who had [[Color|black]] [[hair]], brown [[eye]]s, and tan skin. They conducted themselves in an appropriate manner, greeting the more senior Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi upon his visit to their classroom.<ref name="AOTC" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|Use your feelings, you must.|Yoda, to Mari Amithest and their classmates|<ref name="AOTC" />}}
Amithest was [[Force-sensitive]] and therefore possessed the [[Force power|powers]] of [[the Force]]. As a youngling, they received an introductory course in lightsaber techniques from Yoda, who taught Amithest to let their intuition guide their actions.<ref name="AOTC" />

==Equipment==
While training with Yoda, Amithest wore tan [[Jedi apparel|Jedi robes]], a brown [[belt]], and a gray training [[Armor|helmet]]. They used a training [[lightsaber]] to practice their skills at blocking simulated [[blaster]] bolts.<ref name="AOTC" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:MariAmithest.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Mari Amithest was portrayed by Phoebe Yiamkiati.]]
Mari Amithest was portrayed by [[Phoebe Yiamkiati]] in the [[2002]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']] and was identified in the film's credits.<ref name="AOTC" /> The character was identified as simply "Jedi Child May" in the film's script<ref name="Old DB">{{DB|organization|bearclan|Bear Clan}}</ref> and originally responded to Yoda's question with "If the planet blew up, the [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] would go away."<ref name="Art">''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode II: Attack of the Clones]]''</ref>
